The King Asks about Escaping Enemies
A4095: قال الملك للفيلسوف قد سمعت المثل الذي ضربت فاضرب لي الآن إن رأيت مثل رجل كثر عدوّه وحصروه من كلّ جانب فأشرف للهلكة فالتمس المخرج بموالاة بعض العدوّ ومصالحته فسلم ممّا يتخوّف ووفى لمن صالح منهم فأخبرني عن موضع الصلح وكيف يُلتمس ذلك
A4095-Mc-English: “I have heard the parable you presented,” said the King to the Philosopher. “Present to me now, if you will, the parable of a man whose enemies are many and surround him on every side; who is on the brink of perishing; who sought a way out by partnering with one of the enemies, reconciling with him; who was saved from that he feared; and who kept his promise to the one enemy with whom he had reconciled. Tell me about the nature of truce and how that is sought.

CCCP578-Mc-English: “I have understood what you mentioned of the matters of knowledge and reason,” said the King to the Philosopher, “and how a man of both benefits and gains merit.
